basic_info.description: Stunning one bedroom TIC, Pacific Heights location. Classic architectural building, built in 1890, remodeled in spring of 2016 with new modern/high tech appliances. Approximately 654 sq. ft.  Kitchen offers 30 Wolf gas range, with hood, a new Samsung refrigerator with filtered water and ice dispenser.  New disposal, microwave, tile floors, Bosch dishwasher, white quartz countertops, with glass tile back splash and under counter LED lighting.    The bathroom has a Carrera marble slab shower with crystal clear Starphire glass door and enclosure. A large beveled mirror sits above the matching Carrera marble vanity, and you'll enjoy a mosaic tile floor with adjustable radiant floor heat. In the spacious living room, you will find lots of natural light, and 12-18 foot ceilings. This living space opens up to a private deck, and is perfect for relaxing. The luxurious bedroom has a large window, natural light, and large closets.    This location is in a vibrant area with restaurants, shops, and gyms just a few blocks away on the very popular Union & Polk Streets. A very walkable neighborhood, and Muni and Google bus lines are around the corner. Washer/dryer located in lower level, and street parking only.
